WHAT'S YOUR RETURN AND REFUND POLICY?
Our return window is 14 DAYS AFTER YOU RECEIVE THE ITEM. To be eligible, the item must be IN ORIGINAL CONDITION, UNWORN OR UNUSED, WITH TAGS ATTACHED, IN THE ORIGINAL PACKAGING, AND WITH RECEIPT OR PROOF OF PURCHASE.
A $9.99 RESTOCKING FEE is deducted from each refund. INTERNATIONAL ORDERS EXCEPT CANADA, INTIMATES, BODYSUITS, JEWELRY, ALL MARKDOWN/SALE ITEMS, AND GIFT CARDS ARE NON-RETURNABLE. Items returned with MAKEUP, SELF-TANNER, DEODORANT, PET HAIR, OR STAINS are STORE CREDIT ONLY, and the same applies to FINAL-SALE ITEMS.
To start a return, exchange, or request for a return label, please use our return portal: https://nakedwardrobe.com/apps/aftership-returns-center
Once your return is received and inspected, your refund is issued to the ORIGINAL PAYMENT METHOD WITHIN 10 BUSINESS DAYS, though your bank may take additional time to post it. If it’s been MORE THAN 14 BUSINESS DAYS SINCE WE RECEIVED YOUR RETURN, please contact NW@NAKEDWARDROBE.COM. For return questions, you can also reach RETURNS@NAKEDWARDROBE.COM.
